column1: # Frozen settings for the C4 development-donor LEAVE-ONE-OUT campaign. Committed before any donor of
# this campaign is run, and bound into every run's signature.
# TWO LINEAGES MEET HERE, and both are recorded rather than collapsed into one number:
#   READS come from the ordinary-LZO lineage (tests/genotype_coverage_settings.tsv): seed 20260916,
#   UNSALTED. That is the stream the eight frozen development sources under
#   CALLER SETTINGS come from the grouped-prefix lineage
#   (tests/genotype_c4_heldout_mosaic_manifest.tsv): proposal width 256, arms K=0 and K=128, phase
# THINNING IS UNSALTED, and that is a correction. The first run of this campaign passed
# `--name-salt <donor>` to subsample, copying tests/genotype_coverage_c4.sh, whose round-9 revision
# salts the thinning selector. But the frozen SOURCES predate that revision: they are one realization
# per donor from a shared, unsalted stream. Thinning an unsalted source with a salted selector chooses
# a different subset from the one ordinary LZO would choose, which destroys the paired comparison that
# is the entire reason for reusing this seed. The selector here is therefore the original one --
# `fnv1a64_fmix64_top53_v1` over "/<fragment name>", with no salt -- and subsample.tsv must record
# name_salt = none. Every retained-fragment count below was produced by that selector and is gated.
# At 30x the requested fraction is 1.0, so the regenerated subset is not merely equivalent to the
# frozen source but byte-identical to it. That is checked for all eight donors, and is the strongest
# available statement that the campaign scores the same reads ordinary LZO scored.
# The round-7 combination -- proposal width 1024, mosaic K 8, phase audit 256 -- is REJECTED by name
# in the manifest gate. NA19240 reaches the blockwise availability floor only at K=128 (distance 4,
# against 6 for the whole panel at K=0), so a K=8 cohort measures a different question.
# The scorer caps and cache budget below are EXPERIMENTAL overrides for this campaign, passed
# explicitly and bound into provenance. The global defaults are unchanged: 2e9 piece hits, 5e8
# physical origins, 2e8 state classes, 2e8 mass cells, 2e9 latent pairs, and no emission cache.
# Inputs bound by content. The campaign refuses if any of these has moved.
# The eight frozen sources, bound by the content of the UNCOMPRESSED reads and the library. A changed
# read file cannot pass unnoticed, and neither can a source silently reordered or re-simulated.
# Retained fragment counts under the UNSALTED selector, one row per donor and coverage. These are the
# whole point of freezing the selector: a salted run, a changed source or a changed subsampler moves
# these numbers, and the campaign refuses rather than scoring a different subset than it claims to.
# At 30x every fragment is retained and the regenerated FASTQ is byte-identical to the frozen source.
# Acceptance, checked at the end of the campaign rather than declared and forgotten. The donor is
# named here rather than hard-coded in the harness, so the same verdict serves the held-out cohort.
# UNRESOLVED HELD-OUT-COHORT DESIGN CASE, recorded here so the cohort cannot begin without ruling on
# it. HG00096 is held_out, and its haplotype1 path IS this campaign's reference path. Leave-one-out on
# HG00096 removes the reference: measured, `loo-gfa` accepts it and reports "removed 2 paths", the
# resulting graph has no reference path, and `genotype` then exits 0 with MODEL_INCOMPLETE. It does
# name the cause -- the unsuffixed <prefix>.mosaic_status.tsv carries "the structural model could not
# be built: Reference path not found: HG00096#1#haplotype1-0000024:31848049-32074186" -- but it writes
# no K-ARM status, so a harness that reads only call.<cov>.K<k>.mosaic_status.tsv sees nothing at all
# and `evaluate` fails with "cannot read ...mosaic_status.tsv". The classifier below therefore falls
# back to the unsuffixed status and reports its note, so this can never present as a crash. The scheme
# has no meaning for the donor that defines the coordinate frame, so the question is whether the
# reference donor is excluded from the held-out cohort, or the cohort is run against a reference that
# is not a panel donor. Sol rules; the cohort does not start first.
